description: This PHP source file defines the 'MyLeadsDashlet' class, which extends the 'DashletGeneric' class to implement a custom dashboard widget (dashlet) for displaying user-specific lead information within the SuiteCRM application. The file includes class constructor logic that initializes dashlet properties and loads related data configuration.
